From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>

Subject: CEOs onsite — transportation, EA coverage & security passes

Morning team,

We’re finalizing the logistics for Aureon’s CEO + EA arrival on 3/18. High level items I need folks to confirm by EOD Friday: 

- Airport pickup: two sedans + one SUV for luggage. ETA 10:30am (SFO) — TravelOps (Marco) to confirm driver and manifests.
- Short overnight hotel: one king + one double at The Beacon (check-in 3/18, check-out 3/19). We'll need express check-in and a room key left at the desk for the CEO.
- EA coverage: Laura, can you own the morning escort (meet & greet, security passes) and Marissa can be the on-site contact for the afternoon workshop run-of-show?
- Security passes: we’ll need temporary badges preprinted and kiosk access enabled. Kayla/Olivia, please confirm the full name spellings and preferred photo ID for expedited printing.

Attachments: VIP_arrival_checklist_v2.pdf (current checklist), EA_shift_roster.xlsx (proposed schedule).

If there are any travel constraints (mobility, dietary), flag them here and I’ll feed into hospitality.

Thanks — David
David Kim
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference

From: Kayla Ruiz <kayla.ruiz@aureon.com>

Thanks David — quick answers below.

- Names for badges: 
  * Marcus Hale (CEO) — passport Marcus.Hale_passport.pdf (will send separately to Marco for driver).
  * Teresa Lin (Chief of Staff / EA) — Teresa.Lin_ID.jpg
- Hotel: Beacon is fine — we’ve requested an adjacent quiet-floor upgrade for Marcus.
- Arrival: Both Marcus and Teresa land 10:12am (SFO) on UA263. They’ll collect bags; driver should be instructed to check for “Aureon — Marcus Hale”.
- Dietary: Marcus is vegetarian, Teresa has a nut allergy.

Marco (TravelOps) — can you confirm driver name and cell number so we can provide to TSA if needed?

Appreciate the checklist. Kayla
Aureon, Head of Events

Marissa, I’ll assign you the workshop floor lead and you’ll receive the final run-of-show by COB Monday (3/15).

I’ll be on the conference bridge for 30 minutes after arrival in case any escalation needed.

Outcomes needed by EOD Friday:
- Laura: badge queue confirmation + contact for security ops
- Marissa: confirm on-site laptop + AV check at 8:00am on 3/18
- Kayla/Olivia: confirm Marcus ID (sent) and Teresa photo (sent)
